links.outcome: Accuracy and safety of LLM responses to substance use disorder queries, fact-checked against SAMHSA/FDA guidelines
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 suggested unsafe opioid microdosing; LLaMA-2 referenced nonexistent resources and improper Xanax sharing; both showed severe inaccuracies in SUD contexts.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 suggested unsafe opioid microdosing; LLaMA-2 referenced nonexistent resources and improper Xanax sharing, both showing severe inaccuracies in SUD contexts.

screen.reason: The study conducts an empirical evaluation (clinician-blind evaluation and fact-checking against guidelines) of LLMs (ChatGPT-4 and LLaMA-2) responding to substance use disorder queries sourced from Reddit, assessing accuracy and safety risks.
